summary: Iteration 2 testing — streak counter and PNG-share recap modal. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passing including 4 new streak-specific tests (fields presence, walk-back skip-current, gap-breaks, under-goal). Frontend: full Playwright flow validated — streak-badge appears with correct count, all-time card shows current/best streak, Share button enables only when current week has rides, modal opens with all required content (KM Ledger header, week label W19·2026, hero number, % of goal, ride count, streak badge, progress bar, 7 day-bars, longest ride, all-time km, IN PROGRESS/GOAL HIT status), Download PNG triggers download with filename km-ledger-2026-W19.png, X-button + backdrop both close modal, share disabled on empty future week.
critical_code_review_comments: _compute_streaks best-streak loop has a subtle correctness concern: when run is reset to 0 on under-goal week and prev_key is set, the next at-goal week takes the contiguous branch (prev_key+1==k) and run becomes 1 from 0 — works in practice but logic flow is harder to read. Consider explicit reset to 1 on under-goal break.
RecapShareModal: clicking *anywhere* inside the recap-card propagates to backdrop only because of stopPropagation on inner wrapper — current implementation correctly stops it. OK.
Backend create_ride returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation — minor REST convention deviation (existing behavior, not new).
html2canvas can occasionally fail on unsupported CSS (e.g., oklch); current modal uses safe colors so OK, but worth keeping in mind.
seed_data_creation: Test seeded TEST_STREAK_* and TEST_UI_* rides via API for streak walk-back/gap/under-goal scenarios and UI flows; all cleaned up at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Streak logic verified end-to-end. Backend _compute_streaks handles walk-back (skip incomplete current), gap-breaking, and under-goal correctly. Frontend RecapShareModal renders square 1:1 card and uses html2canvas for PNG export — verified download event fires with km-ledger-{weekKey}.png filename. data-testids present: streak-badge, current-streak, best-streak, open-share-btn, share-modal, recap-card, close-share-modal, download-recap-btn.
